content.short: We’re here to make digital events that people can get excited about.
content.description:
We’re here to make digital events that people can get excited about. We're an all-in-one virtual events platform that builds shared experiences for the music community.

The Futurebots are a collection of quirky music loving robots that travel the metaverse in search of good vibes. Each Futurebot in the collection is unique and has been algorithmically created from a pool of traits of varying rarities.

They serve as a PFP, Exclusive Virtual Event Ticket, provide in-game items, 3 Airdrops (DFB perk) & a playable character.
